name: Ophelia Lancaster
original_name: オフィーリア・ランカスター
source:
Affiliation: Kisaragi Magic Academy 2nd year, Group A
Favorite food: Pancakes
Gift: Unlimited (can create illusions)

Ophelia is the self-proclaimed rival of Sally. If she has one good point, then that would be her hardworking nature. She thinks hard work can beat a genius but that doesn't apply to Sally, a genius who also works hard.

[From [url=http://visualnovelspam.blogspot.fi/2013/12/hhg-megami-no-shuuen-thoughts.html]Visual Novel Spam[/url]]
